title: TSH receptor antibodies
what: This blood test looks for special antibodies that can make your thyroid work too hard.
why: When your thyroid hormones are high and the cause is not clear. Also to check treatment, and in pregnancy if you have had thyroid problems before.
duration: the blood draw takes a few minutes; results usually come in 1 to 5 days
tell_doctor: If you take vitamins or supplements with biotin. It can affect the result
If you are pregnant or planning a pregnancy
If you had radioactive iodine treatment or thyroid surgery

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: Morning is best. Many labs advise coming on an empty stomach. Check ahead.

prepare.title: Biotin
prepare.text: If you take biotin, ask your doctor how many days before the test to stop it.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Tell your doctor what you take. They will decide if anything needs to change before the test.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A sleeve you can easily roll up above the elbow.

bring: Your referral or list of tests
Your thyroid ultrasound report, if you have one
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tied above your elbow, and you are asked to clench your fist a few times
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
A quick prick. Blood fills the tubes in a few seconds
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
You can eat right away and go back to your usual day
An endocrinologist, a hormone doctor, will explain the result together with your other hormone tests
red_flags: The puncture site is very swollen, painful, and red

faq.q: If the antibodies are high, does that mean Graves disease?
faq.a: It is an important sign, but the doctor decides based on all your tests and an exam.

faq.q: Will I need to repeat this test?
faq.a: Sometimes, yes. The doctor may repeat it during treatment to decide when to stop.

reminders.text: TSH receptor antibody test tomorrow. Morning is best. Follow what you agreed with your doctor about biotin.
